transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function for the Rust 1.96 target body.
Extracted the target-local ChunkBy representation with private `slice` and `predicate` fields, preserving field names, order, types, and privacy while omitting Rust stability/doc attributes.
Included ChunkBy::new with the real Rust body `ChunkBy { slice, predicate }` so the target call is verified rather than trusted.
Adapted the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[T]` parameter and named return for Verus; the executable body remains the single call `ChunkBy::new(slice, pred)`.
Preserved the Rust callback bound `F: FnMut(&T, &T) -> bool`; the harness never invokes the callback in the constructor proof and uses only the audited `fnmut_adjacent_predicate_observed` vocabulary.

Defined the closed iterator-view helper and open adjacent-chunk helper from the extracted initial iterator state to expose source, remaining, empty yielded prefix/remainder, zero chunk size, forward direction, and predicate-observation lawfulness.

Revealed the closed iterator-view definition in ghost proof blocks and added a trigger to the local predicate-observation quantifier; these are proof-only annotations with no executable data-flow effect.
